product: The Eleanor Weekender — Cognac proposed; one nominal size
script:
If you're going to Europe this fall, here's how I'd style one beautiful travel bag for Paris, Milan and London. Three different looks, without buying a whole new wardrobe for every stop.

This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra. I'd go for Cognac. That warm leather against the light canvas gives you such a beautiful starting point for your travel outfits.

Starting with Paris, I'd keep everything relaxed. Straight-leg jeans, a cream knit, a trench and loafers. Then carry the Eleanor by the top handles. The bag gives those simple pieces a more finished look, even when you're just arriving at your hotel.

For Milan, I'd dress it up. Tailored trousers, a fitted knit, a long coat, and a little gold jewelry to pick up the hardware. The same bag suddenly feels much more polished because of what you've put around it.

And for London, I'd have a little more fun. A checked jacket, relaxed trousers, comfortable sneakers. Let the textures do the work. The canvas and leather sit so nicely alongside those autumn layers.

That's what I like about building your travel wardrobe around a bag like this. You can change the whole mood with your clothes, and your weekender still feels like part of the outfit.

Because the outfit you wear between cities deserves just as much thought as the one you wear when you get there.

So, Paris, Milan or London—which look would you wear? Shop the Eleanor Weekender at Velantra.
